header.title: AI Tutor & Smart Grader
header.subtitle: Automatic visual analysis of handwriting that works as a Valid Expert Mentor. It shows good and bad sides, detects errors and generates a points format.

mode.title: Grading Mode
mode.autoSegmentingDesc: You don't have to pick a specific task. Photograph a whole page of the student's test. The algorithm will detect all tasks, segment them and grade them one by one automatically.

upload.title: Handwriting Image
upload.attachDesc: Photograph the student's test or notebook for automatic checking.
upload.pickStudent: Pick a student from a class
upload.noGradebookEntry: The analysis will be saved, but no gradebook entry: pick a student from a class so the grade lands on a real person.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.emptyState: Select an image to generate automatic feedback and a grade based on Bloom's Taxonomy.
analysis.comparingHandwriting: Comparing the handwriting with the algorithm
analysis.batchDetected: The algorithm detected and graded a total of {{count}} tasks from the image.

result.noErrors: No errors found. The task is solved correctly.
